description: Central Bank of Sri Lanka - Order made to repeal the exemption granted in respect of payment for goods exported from Sri Lanka in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 759/15 of 26.03.1993
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically, a notice issued under the Exchange Control Act that repeals a previous exemption, requires repatriation of payments, and establishes new regulatory requirements for foreign exchange. While it mentions Minister Ravi Karunanayake by name, it does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities (only his title "Minister of Finance"), and the core content is about regulatory changes rather than government personnel or structural matters. The notice constitutes a statutory instrument under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette.
